about: Byte copies of the identity/v1 files the client's token verifier is tested with (agentteam-deployments docs/development/CONTRACTS.md C4: one sha256 per file, SHA256SUMS here). Provider: agentrouter-top/agentrouter-newapi contracts/identity/v1. The TEST-ONLY keys are the provider's published test keys; never configure them anywhere. Refresh: copy the files at the new commit, rewrite SHA256SUMS (sha256sum over contracts/, sorted), update commit, in the same PR as the code change.
